subject.title: Feature: configurable LLM profiles with fast model switching in Telegram

question: Should this be limited to an ordered curated picker over existing model aliases, or should selecting a profile atomically change additional settings such as reasoning, fallbacks, runtime, and authentication profile?
rationale: Current main already has stable aliases and session model overrides, while bundling further settings would create new compatibility-sensitive configuration, authorization, and session-state contracts that existing behavior does not define.

options.title: Curated aliases only
options.body: Render configured model aliases in explicit order as portable `/model` choices while preserving the current session model-override contract.

options.title: Full runtime profiles
options.body: Define a new generic profile contract with explicit persistence, reset, authorization, validation, and status rules for every switchable setting.

options.title: Keep current picker
options.body: Retain provider browsing and direct alias commands without adding another configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Curated aliases only
recommendation.body: Render configured model aliases in explicit order as portable `/model` choices while preserving the current session model-override contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest merged work and shared-helper history on model selection and session preservation make this the strongest available routing candidate.
